settings.title: Sorema Group
settings.text:
Sorema is the family group behind Corvo. It began in 1974 in the north of Portugal, and is now in its fourth generation.

Corvo is its atelier for bespoke rugs.
settings.image_alt: A Sorema display of bath towels in many colours on curved white shelves, with a group of visitors

settings.title: It began with an act of courage
settings.text:
Fifty years ago Ramiro Relvas, with his son Duarte and his friend Henrique Soares, began the project that would grow into the Sorema group. He wanted something of his own.

His first venture, car upholstery, had to be rethought after the Portuguese Revolution of 25 April 1974, when assembly lines left the country. He did not give up. Sorema went on to make bath linens and accessories, and never stopped making tufted rugs.

settings.title: Three brands, one family
settings.text: The Corvo brand was born within a family of brands inspired by the Azores, the family's favourite holiday destination.

settings.title: An atelier with a group behind it
settings.text:
Corvo was established in 2023 as a sister company of Sorema, with one purpose: luxury bespoke rugs, tufted by hand.

It works in Silvalde, Espinho, where its team has made rugs for more than fifty years. Yarn is dyed in-house, and every batch is tested in the colour laboratory for colour fastness and consistency.
